name: Soyuz-11
about: Soyuz-11 (1971-053A), a crewed vehicle (7K-TX), launched 1971 Jun  6. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1971 Jun 13), held fixed
docked to S05160; it stays docked here until it lands; the undocking is folded into the landing (a fudge of hours)
the landing time is GCAT's end of mission (psatcat TDate); the point stands in for the programme's usual recovery area, from memory

events.why: GCAT gives the launch without an hour
the hour is GCAT's; the site is estimated
